title: Lighthouse with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky hint: stars -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='14' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='10' r='1.2' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='28' r='1' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='25' r='1.3' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='40' r='1' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='1' fill='#FFE066'/>
  
  <!-- light beams -->
  <polygon points='50,22 10,8 18,20' fill='#FFEE99' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='50,22 90,8 82,20' fill='#FFEE99' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- lighthouse body (base wider) -->
  <polygon points='35,92 65,92 58,40 42,40' fill='#E84A4A'/>
  
  <!-- white stripes -->
  <rect x='40' y='55' width='20' height='10' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <rect x='42' y='72' width='16' height='10' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  
  <!-- stripe edges as lighter red shades -->
  <rect x='40' y='53' width='20' height='2' fill='#F57878'/>
  <rect x='40' y='65' width='20' height='2' fill='#F57878'/>
  <rect x='42' y='70' width='16' height='2' fill='#F57878'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='16' height='2' fill='#F57878'/>
  
  <!-- top gallery/platform -->
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='24' height='5' rx='1' fill='#444466'/>
  <rect x='38' y='35' width='24' height='2' rx='1' fill='#6666AA'/>
  
  <!-- lantern room -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='14' height='12' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='44' y='25' width='12' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#FFEE88'/>
  
  <!-- lantern light glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='5' fill='#FFFFCC' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- roof / cap -->
  <polygon points='50,12 40,24 60,24' fill='#CC3333'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 42,24 58,24' fill='#E84A4A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  
  <!-- cute smiling face on the tower -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='50' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='48.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44,57 Q50,63 56,57' stroke='#2A2A4A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- door at base -->
  <rect x='46' y='82' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#553333'/>
  <rect x='46' y='82' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#664444'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='88' r='0.8' fill='#FFD700'/>
  
  <!-- base ground -->
  <rect x='30' y='92' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#777799'/>
  <rect x='30' y='92' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#9999BB'/>
  
  <!-- little rocks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='94' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#8888AA'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='94' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#8888AA'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='95' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#9999BB'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='95' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#9999BB'/>
</svg>
